summary: Bind adoption workflow pins from required-check registry

delivery.outcome: Resolve revision-bound adoption workflows from a managed registry and verify both immutable pins
nonGoals: Do not allow arbitrary workflow paths from ticket intent
Do not allow mutable refs or mismatched pins
Do not widen target workstream ownedPaths

architecture.decision: Ship a managed exact-path registry and derive atomic target bindings only when the registered workflow contains both canonical new-project pins bound to standardAdoption.toRevision
interfaceChanges: Managed adoption-binding registry declares revision-bound workflow paths
architecture.rollback: Remove the managed registry and workflow-binding derivation together

validation.evidence: Custom registered path passes and missing/mismatched pins fail closed
Registry and schema ship as managed digest-bound files

commands: for test_script in tests/*.test.sh; do bash "$test_script"; done
